label: Seasons
title: Seasons
intro: The old calendar divides the year into twenty-four seasons. The house follows them.

sections.heading: 二十四節気
body: Each season lasts about fifteen days. Its name says what to look for: frost, rain, the first heat. Dates are approximate and shift by a day from year to year.
